name: oberth
description: Oberth CI over MCP: one events_wait kept open instead of polling, assisted-continuation holds serviced within their TTL, and the rule that an assisted run is never evidence.

url.title: Oberth MCP URL
url.description: MCP endpoint of your Oberth server, for example https://oberth.example.test:30443/mcp

token.title: Uplink token
token.description: Bearer token of your Oberth uplink. Kept in Claude Code's credential store.

ca_pin.title: CA SHA-256 pin
ca_pin.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the server's CA certificate, from your Oberth admin (oberth client pin). /oberth:connect trusts the CA only when it matches. Leave empty when the server has a publicly trusted certificate.
